title: 第8章 七阶大丹师第9章 大罗金清丹
content_zh:
一炉九丹，枚枚上品。
震惊了现场所有人。
即使是陈元良，一生之中，仅仅炼出过三枚上品真元丹。
即便如此，也是陈元良在双木城最骄傲的资本了。
可在陆沉这一炉子丹前面，那一点骄傲的资本瞬间消失得无影无踪。
“妖孽！”
除了这两个字，现场众人实在找不到形容陆沉的词言了。
“不可能！”
周鸿满脸惊骇，脸上的肌肉不停抽搐，突然歇斯底里吼了出来，“他年纪轻轻，也没有丹袍加身，无阶无品，怎么可能炼出上品真元丹作弊，一定是作弊！”
“现场炼丹，我怎么个作弊法”
陆沉看着暴走的周鸿，不由冷笑起来。
看来周鸿是不想给灵气丹，输了找个由头，想赖账啊。
“你一定用了障眼法，偷偷换掉丹炉里面的丹药。”
“你白痴啊，现场这么多高手，我换得掉么再说，我上那里找九枚上品真元丹”
现场的人眼神都古怪起来。
他们都看出来了，周鸿强词夺理，是输了不认账的表现啊。
不过，碍于周鸿的势力，无人敢出来说一句公道话。
这时侯，陈元良发话了。
“陆沉炼丹作弊，必须严惩，以儆效尤！”
现场一阵死寂。

所有人都心明如镜，陈元良这是要偏护周鸿，拿陆沉开刀啊。
“跟我斗丹，你小子还不够资格。”
周鸿终于转怒为笑，笑得十分狰狞。
“狼狈为奸！”
陆沉扫了一眼陈元良和周鸿，当众怒骂两人。
“拿下，关地牢！”
陈元良喝道。
周鸿伸手一探，向陆沉抓来。
啪！
一个耳光响起。
周鸿的脸上多了一个巴掌印。
“你敢打我”
周鸿大怒，当即运转全身灵气，炼体境九重的气息爆发。
“去死吧！”
周鸿一掌拍来，掌风呼啸，震憾全场。
陆沉也不躲闪，直接气息崩发，一掌迎上。
嘭！
两掌相交，爆出巨响。
陆沉不动如山。
content_en:
A furnace of nine elixirs, each one of high quality.
It shocked everyone present.
Even Chen Yuanliang only refined three high-grade True Yuan Pills in his life.
Even so, it is Chen Yuanliang's most proud asset in Shuangmu City.
But in front of Lu Chen's furnace pill, that little bit of pride disappeared without a trace in an instant.
"Monster!"
Apart from these two words, no one at the scene could find any words to describe Lu Chen.
"Impossible!"
Zhou Hong's face was full of horror, the muscles on his face kept twitching, and he suddenly shouted hysterically, "He is young, does not have a pill robe to wear, and has no rank or grade. How can he cheat by refining a high-grade True Yuan Pill? It must be cheating!"
"Refining alchemy on the spot, how can I cheat?"
Lu Chen couldn't help but sneered when he looked at Zhou Hong who was running away.
It seems that Zhou Hong doesn't want to give Lingqi Pill a reason to lose, and wants to default on the debt.
"You must have used a cover-up trick to secretly change the pills in the pill furnace."
"You idiot, there are so many masters here, can I change them? I'll go there to find nine high-grade True Essence Pills."
The eyes of the people present looked strange.
They all saw that Zhou Hongqiang's arrogant words were a sign of refusing to admit defeat.
However, due to Zhou Hong's power, no one dared to say a fair word.
At this time, Chen Yuanliang spoke.
"Lu Chen cheated in alchemy and must be severely punished to serve as a warning to others!"
There was a dead silence.
Everyone was as clear as a mirror. Chen Yuanliang wanted to protect Zhou Hong and take action on Lu Chen.
"You're not qualified to fight elixirs with me."
Zhou Hong finally turned his anger into laughter, and his smile was very ferocious.
"Working together!"
Lu Chen glanced at Chen Yuanliang and Zhou Hong and scolded them in public.
"Take it and put it in the dungeon!"
Chen Yuanliang shouted.
Zhou Hong reached out and grabbed Lu Chen.
Snap!
A slap sounded.
Zhou Hong had a slap mark on his face.
"How dare you hit me"
Zhou Hong was furious, and immediately circulated his spiritual energy throughout his body, and the breath of the ninth level of the body refining realm exploded.
"Go to hell!"
Zhou Hong slapped him with a palm, and the wind roared, shocking the whole audience.
Lu Chen didn't dodge, he immediately released his breath and met him with a palm.
Bang!
The two palms met and there was a loud noise.
The land is as motionless as a mountain.
